description: This file defines the code-behind for an ASP.NET webpage 'SetExam1' in an online exam system. It includes event handlers for UI controls such as buttons to navigate to different pages within the application, such as admin panel, leaderboard, theory, and MCQ set pages, as well as a logout function.
